title: Update Dealer Dashboard with Lead Scores
goal: Visualize Lead Scores and enable 'No-Show' reporting in the Dealer Dashboard.

context.requirement: Show Hot/Warm/Cold status, numeric scores, and No-Show controls.

sub_tasks.output: Update Frontend API Client (`src/api.ts`) to fetch scores
Verify UI updates with mock data

acceptance_criteria: Contacts list shows '🔥 HOT', '🟢 WARM', '❄️ COLD' badges.
Clicking a contact shows their detailed score breakdown.
Dealer can click 'Report No-Show' which calls the backend API.
UI refreshes score after No-Show penalty.
